description: This file implements functions for checkpointing and resuming processes, specifically for hibernation management. It defines functions to checkpoint a process and wake it up, using external memory control functions and managing process metadata.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Initiates a checkpoint of a process with a given PID, storing metadata and returning a status code.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Resumes a process from a checkpoint, freeing associated metadata and returning a status code.
